parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $3y^2+6xy\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ as the derivative of $3xy^2$ [B1]. State or imply $3y^2\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ as the derivative of $y^3$ [B1]. Equate the derivative of the left side to zero, substitute $(1,3)$, and find the gradient [M1; for an incorrect derivative the substitution must be seen]. Obtain $\dfrac{10}{3}$ or equivalent [A1; allow 3.33 or better and ignore $30/9$ after the correct answer]. Total 4.
